description: Insomniac Games set a new bar for superhero video games with Marvel's Spider-Man. But with Wolverine, it has a different beast altogether in its hands, one that cannot be tamed by conventional methods. The studio has a reputation for telling safe and sanitised stories in its games, but it needed to find a darker edge for a character like Logan. Marvel's Wolverine fails to do that.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Review: Insomniac's Superhero Slasher Comes With Dull Edges

description: Arya.ag is moving records linked to about $2 billion (roughly Rs. 19,052 crore) worth of stored agricultural produce onto Avalanche. The system will link grain deposits, electronic negotiable warehouse receipts, and financing information, allowing lenders to verify collateral through a shared record. The physical crops will remain in warehouses, while India’s official e-NWRs will continue to serve as financing documents.
title: Arya.ag Plans to Tokenise Grain Ownership Records on Avalanche

description: Unicoin has sued Uniswap Labs in a New York federal court, seeking a declaration that its UNICOIN trademark does not infringe Uniswap’s marks. It is also seeking cancellation of Uniswap’s federal UNI trademark registration, arguing that the term is generic or descriptive. The dispute follows months of correspondence over Unicoin’s use of the name and related domains.
title: Unicoin and Uniswap Face Off in Court Over UNI Trademark

description: Krafton India has released 50 redeem codes alongside BGMI's Midnight Hunters experience. Players can use the codes to claim in-game rewards through the game's official Redeem Centre, with each code available to a maximum of 10 users. The codes support only one redemption per account and one code per player each day. BGMI does not allow guest accounts to use the codes, while rewards sent to in-game mail must be collected within 30 days. The codes remain valid until September 25.
title: BGMI Midnight Hunters Redeem Codes: Check Full List Before September 25

description: Moto Buds 2 Fusion earphones are scheduled to launch in India on September 15. Both Flipkart and Motorola have listed the new true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones on their websites. They have 12.4mm titanium-coated dynamic drivers and Motorola's proprietary audio tuning. They are advertised to offer up to 53 hours of total battery life on a single charge. They feature Dynamic Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) of up to 55dB, along with Transparency Mode. The earbuds have six microphones, with three microphones on each earbud.
title: Moto Buds 2 Fusion India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications Teased

description: Maharashtra is working on a proposed legal framework for tokenising land and immovable property using blockchain technology. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said the state is designing the architecture for the Maharashtra Digitisation and Exchange of Land Token Asset (DELTA) Bill. The initiative aims to improve liquidity and transparency around real-world assets rather than encourage speculative activity.
title: Maharashtra Looks to Establish First State-Level Land Tokenisation Framework, Says CM Fadnavis

description: The Redmi 17 5G is now available for purchase in India, following its launch last week. The handset is the latest addition to the Xiaomi sub-brand’s affordable smartphone lineup and arrives as the successor to the Redmi 15 5G. It features a 6.9-inch HD+ display with up to 120Hz AdaptiveSync, along with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5. The Redmi 17 5G packs a 7,900mAh battery with 45W fast charging.
title: Redmi 17 5G With Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chip Goes on Sale in India: Price, Specifications

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max's A20 Pro chipset has been spotted on multiple benchmarking platforms. On AnTuTu, the iPhone 18 Pro Max’s A20 Pro chipset reportedly managed to score 35,51,073 points in overall performance. Meanwhile, it scored 9,20,410 and 13,97,374 points in AnTuTu’s CPU and GPU performance tests, respectively. The iPhone 18 Pro Max’s A20 Pro chipset, on the other hand, reportedly managed to score 4,612 points on the single-core performance test and 11,819 points on the multi-core performance test. Meanwhile, the iPhone 18 Pro scored 4,719 and 12,677 points on both tests, respectively.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series’ A20 Pro Chipset Appears on Multiple Benchmarking Platforms Showing Performance Gains

description: Flipkart's biggest festive sale of the year could be just around the corner. According to rumours on social media, the e-commerce giant is expected to host its annual Big Billion Days Sale next month. Shoppers will reportedly have a chance to pick up smartphones, electronics, appliances, and other products at discounted prices ahead of the festive season. Like previous years, Flipkart Plus members could get access to the sale event a day earlier than other users.
title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sale 2026 Date, Offers Leaked: Early Access, Bank Discounts and More

description: Samsung has added Certified Re-Newed versions of the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra to its India lineup. The refurbished smartphones are sold through Samsung’s website and Shop app, with the company offering a one-year warranty on both models. Samsung says the devices undergo inspection, refurbishment and testing before sale, with genuine components and certified batteries used where required. The Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra retain their original hardware specifications, including AMOLED displays, multi-camera systems and wireless charging support.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26, S26 Ultra Now Available as Certified Re-Newed Phones in India

description: OnePlus N6 Lite design and colour options have been revealed by the company. The OnePlus N series handset appears in black and green colour options. It is shown to sport a flat rear panel, featuring the square-shaped camera module in the top-left corner of the panel. The phone also appears to have two cutouts inside the camera island, which could be for its dual camera system. However, since it is expected to be an entry-level offering, the phone might feature a single rear camera, paired with a light sensor.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite Design and Colour Options Teased Ahead of India Launch

description: Apple has retired six products from its direct sales lineup following its latest launches. The iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max have made way for the iPhone 18 Pro models, while the Apple Watch Series 11 and Ultra 3 have been replaced by newer generations. The Watch SE 2 has also reached the end of its run after the SE 3 arrived. Apple has similarly discontinued the AirPods 4 following the launch of the AirPods 5, although retailers can continue selling existing stock.
title: Which Apple Products Were Discontinued in 2026? Full List After iPhone 18 Pro Launch

description: Apple has launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in four colour options. They are available in Burgundy, Black, Silver, and Glacier shades in India and other global markets. For comparison, the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max came in Cosmic Orange, Silver, and Deep Blue colours.
title: From Burgundy to Glacier: Every New iPhone 18 Pro Colour Listed and Compared

description: Samsung Research Institute-Noida is playing a growing role in the company’s Galaxy Watch health efforts, working on features such as Vital Tracker, Daily Cardio Load and Hearing Health. Samsung says its watches are focused on wellness and preventive care rather than diagnosis, while services such as Find Care aim to connect users with doctors, medicines and lab tests. We spoke to SRI-Noida executives about the R&D behind Samsung’s latest Galaxy Watches.
title: How Samsung's India R&D Team Shapes Galaxy Watch Health Features: Inside SRI-Noida

description: Motorola has started a new Razr Fold model, which could be launched soon in select global markets. The handset will arrive in a new passport-style form factor, featuring a shorter and wider body. The video also teased the design of the phone, which appears to be similar to its potential competitors. It appears in a black shade, which could be a camouflage case to cover finer design details of the upcoming foldable. It is expected to compete with the iPhone Duo and the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8.
title: Motorola Teases New Passport-Like Razr Fold After Apple’s Launches iPhone Duo

description: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro, bearing model number Xiaomi 2612CRPFFC, has been spotted on Geekbench. The listing shows the device with Qualcomm's SM8845P chipset, which is believed to be the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC. It has an octa-core configuration, featuring two cores clocked at 3.80GHz and six cores running at 3.32GHz. The listing also reveals the tested device's RAM and Android version.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Spotted on Geekbench With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC

description: Vivo has revealed the designs of its upcoming flagship smartphones in China. The smartphone brand has put its X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro up for pre-order and, in the process, revealed their new designs. Vivo’s upcoming X500 series succeeds the Vivo X300 series of devices launched last year. The devices will be announced in China in September.
title: Vivo X500, X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max Designs Revealed in Official Images Ahead of September Launch

description: Xiaomi is expected to expand its flagship smartphone lineup with the Xiaomi 18 series later this year. While the company has yet to publicly reveal any details about the purported lineup, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has now surfaced on a benchmarking platform. The listing offers an early glimpse at its performance and also sheds light on some of its specifications. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max could feature Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship processor, running on Android 17.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Geekbench Scores Reportedly Surface Ahead of Launch, Key Specs Tipped

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ have been spotted in leaked CAD renders. The images show the Ultra model with a flat rear panel, featuring a dual camera system and an LED flash in the top-right corner. Meanwhile, the Galaxy Tab S12+ appears to have a single camera unit on the back. On top of this, the Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra and Galaxy Tab S12+ appear in similar black and silver colour options. On the front, both tablets might sport a flat display.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra, Galaxy Tab S12+ Design Spotted in Leaked ‘High-Quality’ Renders

description: Bitcoin remains near Rs. 74.3 lakh after geopolitical tensions pushed crude prices higher and weighed on risk sentiment. The cryptocurrency has shown resilience compared with equities and briefly moved alongside gold, while weaker spot buying and ETF outflows point to caution among traders.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $78,000 as Geopolitical Tensions Keep Market Volatile

description: Vivo has re-entered the IoT segment in India with its first true wireless stereo earbuds. The Vivo Buds cost Rs. 1,999 and feature 10mm dynamic drivers, Spatial Audio, and DeepX 4.0 sound effects. They also feature four microphones for AI-based call noise cancellation and support Bluetooth 6.1 with two-device multipoint connectivity. Vivo claims up to 50 hours of battery life with the charging case, while a 10-minute charge can provide up to four hours of playback.
title: Vivo Buds Launched in India With Up to 50-Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Apple launched the AirPods 5 with upgrades over the AirPods 4. The earphones are priced at Rs. 14,900 in India. The AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case cost Rs. 17,900. The new model comes with an improved IP57 rating, compared to the IP54 rating on the AirPods 4. Read on to find out which of these premium true wireless headsets is best for you.
title: AirPods 5 vs AirPods 4: What's the Difference?

description: The latest iPhones are finally here. Apple has launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in India, bringing its newest flagship smartphones to the market. If you've been eyeing the brand-new and shiny iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max and want to get your hands on one before everyone else, we've got you covered. Pre-orders for both models will begin soon, and you can snag one as soon as they’re available. Here's where you can pre-order the new iPhones in India.
title: Where to Buy iPhone 18 Pro in India: Apple Store, Amazon, Flipkart and Croma

description: Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro in India on Wednesday, with notable upgrades over its predecessor.  The iPhone 18 Pro is powered by the latest A20 Pro chipset, which is built on a 2nm process. Meanwhile, the iPhone 17 Pro features the A19 Pro SoC, which is built on a 3nm process. The A20 Pro SoC features a seven-core GPU, delivering 40 percent faster graphics performance and increased bandwidth. The iPhone 18 Pro gets a triple rear camera system, led by a 48-megapixel Fusion camera with the latest variable aperture upgrade.
title: iPhone 18 Pro vs iPhone 17 Pro: What's the Difference

description: Apple launched its first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, at its ‘Surprise and Shine' event. The new foldable runs on an A20 Pro chipset and has a dual rear camera unit. It has a 7.6-inch foldable display and a 6.3-inch cover screen. Here, we compare the iPhone Duo with the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra to understand how two premium foldables differ.
title: iPhone Duo vs Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Apple has just announced the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max in India. The smartphones will go on pre-order from 12 September and will go on sale from 18 September. The memory crisis has raised prices drastically, so here’s all you need to know before you buy an iPhone 18 Pro series smartphone in India.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series India Buying Guide: Price, Features, Offers, EMI, Trade-In and More

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are offered in four storage configurations in India. Starting with the cost, the base model of the iPhone 18 Pro, which features 256GB of onboard storage, is priced in India at Rs. 1,64,900. On the other hand, the base model of the iPhone 18 Pro Max, which offers the same storage capacity, is priced at Rs. 1,79,900. The higher-end configuration of the iPhone 18 Pro, which is equipped with 512GB of storage, is priced at Rs. 1,89,900. Meanwhile, the 512GB option of the iPhone 18 Pro Max is priced at Rs. 2,04,900.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Storage Options: Which Variant Offers the Best Value?

description: A20 Pro presents considerable gains over its predecessor—last year's A19 Pro, which powered the iPhone 17 Pro lineup and the iPhone Air. A20 Pro features 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro; its GPU capability is up to 40 percent faster than A19 Pro; and the chip’s AI processing power is double that of A19 Pro.
title: A20 Pro vs A19 Pro: Why the 2NM Chip on iPhone 18 Pro Is a Massive Leap

description: Apple debuts its new A20 Pro processor with the iPhone 18 Pro series. This 2nm-generation chip has a six-core CPU with integrated Neural Accelerators, a seven-core GPU and a dual 16-core Neural Engine. The new chip is claimed to offer 50 percent more memory bandwidth than A19 Pro. It is also said to offer up to 40 percent faster GPU performance, and double AI processing power compared to the previous-generation chipset.
title: Apple A20 Pro Announced for iPhone 18 Pro: 2nm Architecture, 32-Core Neural Engine, and More

description: Apple’s iPhone Duo has finally been announced at Apple’s Surprise and Shine launch event. The company’s first foldable device will function like an iPhone when folded and an iPad Mini when unfolded, and is currently available for pre-order in India. Unlike a standard iPhone, it will have a cover display and a main folding display. We take a closer look at some of its interesting features.
title: iPhone Duo: 5 Things to Know About Apple's First Foldable

description: Apple first previewed iOS 27 at WWDC 2026 in June, giving users an early look at the next major software update for the iPhone. The update has since gone through multiple cycles of developer and public beta releases, allowing users to test several of its new features ahead of the stable rollout. Following the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max and the company's first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, Apple has now confirmed that iOS 27 will be publicly available from next week.
title: iOS 27: Top New Features, List of Compatible Devices, and More

description: Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' event finally took place on Wednesday, and it turned out to be a historic one for the Cupertino-based tech giant in many ways. Apple CEO John Ternus hosted his first major keynote as CEO, following his appointment to the top job earlier this month. The event also marked a major shift in Apple's product strategy, as the company finally entered the foldable smartphone market with the new iPhone Duo. Alongside its first foldable iPhone, Apple unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5.
title: From iPhone 18 Pro to the Foldable Duo: Everything Apple Launched at the Sept 9 Event

description: iPhone 18 Pro series and the iPhone Duo were launched in India and other global markets on Wednesday, along with the new Apple Watch Series 12, Watch Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5. The iPhone Duo's price in India starts at Rs. 2,99,900 for the base variant featuring 256GB of storage. Meanwhile, the price of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at Rs. 1,64,900 and Rs. 1,79,900.
title: iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro Series India Price and Availability Announced: Full Details

description: Apple has finally entered the foldable smartphone market with the launch of its first-ever foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. The book-style foldable joins an increasingly competitive segment that includes Google's recently launched Pixel 11 Pro Fold. Both smartphones feature large inner foldable displays and are designed to offer more screen space for multitasking, but they take different approaches to cameras, software, performance, and battery life.
title: iPhone Duo vs Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold: Price in India, Features and Specifications Compared

description: Apple has detailed new health and fitness capabilities coming to watchOS 27 and iPadOS 27 following its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event. Workout Buddy will gain broader fitness data support and work without an iPhone nearby, while treadmill tracking will use machine learning to improve distance readings. Apple is also adding perimenopause and menopause tracking. On iPad, the redesigned Health app will offer personalised insights, a Longevity section and Health Age, with Apple Intelligence helping users understand their health data across multiple categories.
title: Apple watchOS 27, iPadOS 27 Get New Health and Fitness Features

description: The iPhone 18 Pro Max brings Apple's A20 Pro chipset, a variable-aperture main camera and the C2 cellular modem, while retaining the 6.9-inch 120Hz OLED display of the iPhone 17 Pro Max. It also offers longer video playback and faster wired charging, but weighs more despite sharing the same dimensions. The newer model starts at Rs. 1,79,900 in India, compared with Rs. 1,49,900 for its predecessor. Both phones offer up to 2TB of storage and three 48-megapixel rear cameras.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max vs iPhone 17 Pro Max: Price in India, Features and Specifications Compared
